summary: Two-stage vtable-switching destructor: writes the destructor-phase vtable off_5AD0DC into this[0], frees the child pointer at this+0x10 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when it is non-null, switches the vtable to off_5AD06C, then, when a2 & 1 is set (deleting-destructor flag), releases the object's own heap block via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns the this pointer unchanged.

local_names.this: object whose vtable is switched during destruction
local_names.a2: flag byte; bit 0 selects final heap release

operations.description: Write the destructor-phase vtable off_5AD0DC into this[0] before child cleanup.
When the child pointer at this+0x10 is non-null, free it; otherwise skip child cleanup.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(this[4]) releases the child object stored at offset 0x10.
Write the second/post-destruction vtable off_5AD06C into this[0].
When a2 & 1 is nonzero (deleting-destructor flag), the object's own heap block is freed; otherwise only child cleanup runs.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) releases the object's own heap allocation on final release.
